dedupe_keys.name: 統計年鑑 第12章 運輸及ひ通信 telecommunications series on bodik odcs

description: 統計年鑑 第12章 運輸及び通信 [telecommunications] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 佐賀県. 佐賀県統計年鑑(H30)第12章「運輸及び通信」のデータです. Coverage: 佐賀県. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 佐賀県. Its tags are 統計年鑑. It offers 37 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2020-11-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
